title: Controlling the weather
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Should humans deliberately try to change the weather if a region faces severe drought?
Who should decide whether a weather-modification experiment is acceptable?
What happens if changing weather in one area creates problems somewhere else?
Would you support cloud seeding if scientists said the benefits were possible but uncertain?
Where should the ethical limit be between adapting to weather and trying to control it?
